basic_info.description:
The Towers is a luxury condo building across the street from Oracle Park. Built in 2000, the building offers luxurious resort-style amenities, including a heated outdoor pool and spa, a sun deck with a full BBQ, fire pit, and heat lamps. Residents also enjoy a private fitness center, conference room, business center, and entertainment room. The location is prime. It's located just a block from the Embarcadero waterfront, entertainment, fantastic restaurants, Safeway, and Whole Foods. Easy access to major freeways, Caltrain, shuttles, and Muni.

UNIT FEATURES:

Most Desirable Split floor plan
Abundant Natural Light
Expensive Hardwood Floors throughout
Open gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances
Ample closet space
Washer and dryer in the unit
Private Balcony
Parking Included
Storage Included

COMMUNITY FEATURES:

24h hour attended lobby
Fitness center
Business center and conference room
Outdoor pool and hot tub
Sauna
Sun deck with barbecue and fire pit
Club room

NEIGHBORHOOD FEATURES:

Across from Oracle Park
2 blocks from Caltrain
Walking distance to Financial District
Walking distance to Chase Center
Ferry Building/Farmer's Market

$4,490 monthly
$4,490 Deposit
